create_schedule_cosine_anneal: create a cosine annealing learning rate schedule from min_lr to max_lr over a given cycle length
create_schedule_linear_warmup: create a linear warmup learning rate schedule from min_lr to max_lr over a given number of steps
create_schedule_constant_lr: create a constant learning rate schedule that returns the same lr regardless of step
create_schedule_warmup_cosine: create a learning rate schedule with linear warmup followed by cosine annealing decay
create_schedule_inverse_sqrt: create an inverse square root learning rate schedule with a warmup step floor
